decisions.reason: The location-based gas tariff comparison remains close to the firm's utility-sector data and calculation capabilities, so accumulated learning and in-house R&D support keeping and refining it despite its narrower market niche.

The regional electricity tariff calculator sits squarely in the firm's core knowledge base of tariff data, billing logic and market processes, making it a strong candidate to retain and further develop.

The regional area definition tool complements the central platform and operational services, and the firm's related knowledge should allow it to absorb user feedback and improve the product effectively.

Although the site-specific energy tariff comparison has lower web prominence and some portfolio overlap, it still builds on the firm's established competences and can be improved through customer-specific learning and internal development.
